convert_detectron_to_pytorch: convert a detectron pretrained ResNet-50 or ResNet-101 model to PyTorch format
run_convert_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a detectron model to PyTorch by providing src, dst, and depth arguments
convert_bn_function: convert batch normalization layers from detectron affine channel format to PyTorch style with bias, weight, running_mean, and running_var
convert_conv_fc_function: convert convolution or fully connected layer weights and optional biases from detectron blobs to PyTorch state dict format
review_convert_function: review the convert function that maps detectron ResNet layer keys to PyTorch naming conventions for ResNet-50 and ResNet-101
